title: hieracium maculatum subsp. cretaceum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. cretaceum, commonly known as Crete Hawk's Beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium maculatum subsp. cretaceum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
